newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM says to import coal indefinitely.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM says to import coal indefinitely.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd (ZCCM) will continue importing coal from neighbouring Zimbabwe, which it began following the closure of the local coal mine after heavy flooding in January, a company spokesman said.

"The Maamba coal mine situation has not yet improved to accommodate the requirements of the Nkana smelter, so the exercise of importing coal from Wankie will continue until the situation at Maamba goes back to normal," the spokesman said.
He said ZCCM had so far imported 2,400 tonnes of coal from Wankie Colliery Co Ltd since Maamba coal mine in southern Zambia was closed.
ZCCM's Nkana smelter uses some 250 tonnes of coal per day.
Torrential rains in southern Zambia led to the flooding of Maamba mine and damaged key installations at the plant.
The floods also disrupted water, electricity and sewerage systems in the area, leading to fears of epidemic outbreaks.
ZCCM output has not been affected by the closure of the coal mine.
